verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, the logo is blown up so large that it competes with the quote and is jammed onto the end of the attribution line. The can is also shrunk to a small item floating inside an oversized circle. A keeps the attribution 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' at a readable size with a clearer gap before the logo. In B the attribution shrinks to a barely legible line that runs almost into the logo, so A wins narrowly even though B's quote is slightly bigger.
